mechanism: Rizatriptan (5-HT1B/1D agonist) combined with perphenazine (dopamine antagonist with serotonergic effects) increases risk of serotonin syndrome and additive CNS depression.
action: Monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, tremor, hyperthermia); consider alternative antipsychotic with lower serotonergic activity or alternative triptan if possible.
